prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "särskilt". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "particularly".
Scene: A person admiring one vivid red flower among several pale flowers, gently pointing to the red bloom with a delighted expression.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "särskilt = particularly; picture one thing standing out.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Jag tycker särskilt om den röda blomman.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
